boards.title: Your First Weekend at Mississippi State University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe sequence of campus stops that combines orientation, recreation, history, and a few places to revisit once classes begin.

cards.title: Start with a campus-orientation lap
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · central campus
cards.notes: Walk the perimeter, pick out Lee Hall, Swalm Hall, and Mitchell Memorial Library, then use the lawn as your reference point for later meetups.
cards.short_summary: A central green space that makes the campus layout easier to understand.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU identifies the historic Drill Field as a popular gathering greenspace at the center of campus.
cards.source_title: The Drill Field | Mississippi State University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus greenspace; confirm any event setup or temporary access restrictions on arrival.

cards.title: Pause at the Chapel of Memories
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · near the campus core
cards.notes: Take a quiet exterior look at the chapel and carillon tower; notice the brickwork, then continue through the nearby central-campus paths.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus landmark built with brick from Old Main Dormitory.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU says the chapel was constructed in the mid-1960s with bricks from Old Main Dormitory, which burned in 1959.
cards.source_title: Chapel on Canvas | Mississippi State University
cards.access_notes: The university catalog says it is open to individual students for meditation and prayer; reserved events may affect access.

cards.title: Make the union your information stop
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Colvard Student Union
cards.notes: Locate the Center for Student Activities, scan current event listings, and save one organization or campus program to investigate next week.
cards.short_summary: A practical hub for student organizations, campus services, food, and event spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU's Welcome Center describes the Colvard Student Union as offering food options, student-affairs offices, and event spaces.
cards.source_title: Available Tours | Mississippi State University Welcome Center
cards.access_notes: Building services and events vary by day; check posted schedules before making a special trip.

cards.title: Choose one way to get involved
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Colvard Student Union, Suite 314
cards.notes: Use the organization and event tools to find one interest-based group, then note its next meeting or contact point for a low-stakes follow-up.
cards.short_summary: The campus hub for student organizations and events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Center for Student Activities says MSU has more than 300 student organizations and that CSA is the hub for organizations and events.
cards.source_title: Center for Student Activities | Mississippi State University
cards.access_notes: Located in Colvard Student Union, Suite 314; online event and organization tools are available from the CSA site.

cards.title: Set up a future study anchor
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon · 395 Hardy Road
cards.notes: Walk through the library, identify a comfortable floor or desk area, and bookmark the exhibits page so you can check for new displays later.
cards.short_summary: The main library is also home to exhibitions and special collections.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU Libraries lists Mitchell Memorial Library at 395 Hardy Road and identifies permanent exhibits within the library.
cards.source_title: Library Exhibits | Mississippi State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Check library hours and exhibit access before visiting, especially during breaks or holidays.

cards.title: Find the Lincolniana sculpture
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon · Mitchell Memorial Library
cards.notes: Look for the permanent sculpture display, then pair the visit with a quick browse of the library's digital exhibits for a self-guided history stop.
cards.short_summary: A permanent Lincolniana sculpture display in Mitchell Memorial Library.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU Libraries lists Moody, Tearful Night as a permanent exhibit in Mitchell Memorial Library's Frank and Virginia Williams Collection of Lincolniana.
cards.source_title: Library Exhibits | Mississippi State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Library access and exhibit availability are subject to building hours; verify before visiting.

cards.title: Plan a history-focused return visit
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Mitchell Memorial Library
cards.notes: Use the Welcome Center's tour listing to plan ahead for the Grant papers, memorabilia, and Williams Collection rather than trying to rush the stop.
cards.short_summary: A campus collection pairing Grant materials with Lincolniana.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU's Welcome Center lists a tour of the Ulysses S. Grant Presidential Library and the Frank and Virginia Williams Collection of Lincolniana.
cards.source_title: Available Tours | Mississippi State University Welcome Center
cards.access_notes: The Welcome Center lists a 45-minute tour; arrange a tour or confirm collection access in advance.

cards.entity_name: Charles H. Templeton, Sr. Music Museum
cards.title: Add a compact museum stop
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · campus
cards.notes: Plan a short tour stop to see instruments and sheet music from the Ragtime era, then keep the rest of the afternoon flexible for campus events.
cards.short_summary: A museum collection of instruments and historic music materials.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU's Welcome Center says the museum includes 200 instruments, 13,000 pieces of music, and 15,000 pieces of Ragtime-era sheet music and more.
cards.source_title: Available Tours | Mississippi State University Welcome Center
cards.access_notes: The Welcome Center lists this as a 30-minute tour; confirm tour availability before going.

cards.title: Try one active campus option
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · 225 Bailey Howell Drive
cards.notes: Bring your student ID or membership access, choose a straightforward activity such as the track or pool, and check facility rules before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A recreation center with courts, fitness space, a track, and an indoor pool.
cards.evidence_claim: University Recreation lists basketball/volleyball courts, racquetball courts, fitness equipment, a jogging track, and an indoor swimming pool at the Sanderson Center.
cards.source_title: University Recreation | Mississippi State University Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: Spring/fall weekend hours listed by UREC are Saturday 10 a.m.–7 p.m. and Sunday 2–11 p.m.; hours may vary for holidays and athletics schedules.

cards.title: Finish with a lakeside walk
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · beside the Sanderson Center
cards.notes: Take the walking route around the lake at an unhurried pace, then use the nearby recreation center as your landmark for getting back to campus.
cards.short_summary: A campus outdoor stop next to the Sanderson Center.
cards.evidence_claim: MSU Guest and Conference Services says Chadwick Lake is next to the Sanderson Center and is available for a stroll around the lake.
cards.source_title: University Recreation | Mississippi State University Guest and Conference Services
cards.access_notes: Use for a walk; the same source notes fishing requires a fishing license. Follow posted outdoor-area guidance.
